answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the summit index resolves every citation against the vertex checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the sonnet audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1896 identities would post 2988 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
